dedupe_keys.name: a novel dynamically coupled storm surge hazard infrastructure model for effective real time risk informed decision making

description: A Novel Dynamically Coupled Storm Surge Hazard-Infrastructure Model for Effective Real-Time Risk-Informed Decision Making is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Abdollah Shafieezadeh, Ohio State University (osu.edu). Coastal areas in the US face substantial risk from storm surge. Data from modeling efforts can provide information to decision makers to act against these risks, but available models are limited in scope. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-hwh3-3w47. Keywords: flood defense systems, time-dependent fragility, decision sciences, evacuation decisions. Published 2022-01-03. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
